name: broken-video-raw-ffprobe
title: Checking a damaged video explains the problem in plain language

issue.title: Checking a damaged video shows raw FFprobe output (moov atom not found, memory addresses, internal paths)
issue.expected: A plain message such as 'This file is not a playable video; it may be incomplete or damaged. Import the original recording again.', with the tool output kept for diagnostics.
issue.actual: The status bar shows 'FFprobe could not read this file: [mov,mp4,... @ 0x55e5...] moov atom not found <vault>/work/<id>.mp4: Invalid data found when processing input'.
issue.dt_test: tests/test_media.py: make ffprobe fail on a random-bytes file and assert the MediaToolError text shown to users has no '@ 0x', no work-folder path and no 'moov atom'.
signatures: text@status bar|ffprobe could not read this file
suspected: dt/media.py: probe_media raises MediaToolError('FFprobe could not read this file: ' + error_tail(stderr)), and the UI shows that text as is
